mapper.select: SELECT mn.*, (select count(*) from fund_approval_detail d where d.fund_approval_id = mn.id) as totalNum, (select IFNULL(SUM(general_budget), 0) from project_application pa left join fund_approval_detail fad on pa.id = fad.project_application_id where fad.fund_approval_id = mn.id) as totalBudget FROM fund_approval mn where mn.id = #{id}
